name: learn-anything
description: Teach any topic, practical skills included, to a tested level: baseline, diagnostic, matched material, evidence-graded tests, spaced review.

interface.shortDescription: Tutor any topic to a tested level
interface.longDescription: Asks for the learner's baseline, corrects it with a diagnostic, matches material to the level, grades answers on evidence (execution, measurement, photo, third person, self-report), and schedules spaced review with FSRS from an append-only log.
